sources.title: Fantozzi’s Footsteps (Grass/Sand & Stone)
sources.creator: Fantozzi
sources.credits: Sand footstep recordings: Fantozzi, edited by qubodup (CC0), via OpenGameArt.org.
sources.processing: Resampled44.1 to48kHz; high/lowpass and gentle dynamics compression; impactpeak-aligned crop/fades, stereo placement and level adjustment. Event times must come from final picture edit.

sources.title: MindStream
sources.creator: DST
sources.credits: Music: MindStream by DST (CC0), via OpenGameArt.org.
sources.processing: Optional excerpt; measured loudness normalization, conservative level, fade in/out. Not an AI-generated score.

distribution_note: Six sand recordings are included. MindStream is not vendored; download_music.py fetches the recorded URL and verifies its SHA-256. CC0 terms apply to these audio assets, separate from repository code licensing.
